high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of a research paper titled "Souper-Model: How Simple Arithmetic Unlocks State-of-the-Art LLM Performance." The paper is authored by a team of researchers from Meta SuperIntelligence Labs, FAIR at Meta, and University College London. The authors' names include Shalini Maiti, Amar Budhiraja, Bhavul Gauri, Gaurav Chaurasia, Anton Protopopov, Alexis Audran-Reiss, Michael Slater, Despoina Magka, Tatiana Shavrina, Roberta Raileanu, and Yoram Bachrach
